limitations: Authored role profiles, not sampled people.
Executor audit establishes exposure and accounting, not semantic truth or human comprehension.
Interest is a retrospective model rating, not a calibrated audience score.
Media coverage is source advancement plus sampled frames, not continuous viewing or listening.
All finish clocks fall below 333.6–500.4 seconds from assumed 300–200 WPM scenarios; no human reference or correction factor.
No B was created; no A/B treatment effect can be estimated.
Public derivative omits full draft/media, raw requests, private operational records and local identifiers. Independent replay of the original live calls is not possible from this summary alone.

framing.text: Executable geometry makes requirements and failures inspectable beyond a render.
Code, checks and repair histories are candidate training material; held-out learning benefit needs a separate test.
A successful build or high score can still miss a declared requirement; checks and human acceptance remain distinct.
